title: Chapter 179: The Strategy Of Defeating Qin
content:
Chapter 179: The Strategy Of Defeating Qin

Han Fei didn't keep Zhong Yu waiting for too long, but within ten minutes, he came to Zhong Yu's cubicle.

"Mr. Han Fei, I have admired your name for a long time, please sit down!" Sitting in his seat, Zhong Yu pointed to an empty seat next to him, motioning for Han Fei to sit on it.

"Thank you, Your Highness. I don't know if Your Highness asked Han Fei to come here. What advice do you have?" Han Fei didn't have any euphemisms, but said straight to the point.

"Okay, it's simple enough. I don't play and I don't like those twists and turns. I called you this time. I want to ask Your Highness, what do you think of Korea today?" With a smile, Zhong Yu made a sharp question. The problem.

"South Korea is the weakest country in the world. The land is less than a thousand miles away, the population is only a million, and the army is only 100,000. For big countries such as Qin and Chu, if there is no external force, it is just a small country that can be destroyed with the palm of your hand!" Han Fei His face changed, but he still said the truth.

"Very good, you didn't lie to me, sir! Then, if South Korea with 100,000 troops can sustain the attack of Qin's 300,000 troops, how about three months?" Zhong Yu nodded, very satisfied with Han Fei Attitude.

"In South Korea, there are only a dozen cities now, and there are only more than 700,000 people. If the whole country is recruited, there will be 150,000 soldiers. If all of them are gathered in Xinzheng, a big city, to resist Qin's 300,000 troops, three One month is still possible!" After pondering for a while, Han Fei calculated the current strength of South Korea and said this answer.

"Very good, if you think that the lonely king will form an alliance with other countries to fight against the tyranny of Qin, is it possible?" After the South Korean side finished speaking, Zhong Yugai asked about the situation in the world.

"Before, the princes of the world have been united four times. Although there were victories and losses, they failed to do their best. Now Qin State occupies half of the homeland of Jin State. In addition to Qin State's Guanzhong, Bashu, half of the world is already in the hands of Qin State. Look again Love, if the six countries in the world work together, even if they work together, the outcome will be unpredictable!" Sighing, Han Fei was also amazed at the previous alliance of the princes, the gap between the six countries is still too large up.

"Qin State, the overlord of the West, has tens of thousands of miles of land and tens of millions of people. Among them, there are nearly 2 million troops who can mobilize for battle. Excluding him, two or three hundred thousand people stay behind, and six to seven million people cultivate. You can also mobilize millions of people to go to war at any time, how can you not look down on the world with such strength." Sitting in his seat, Zhong Yu calmly reported this number that is enough to make all countries in the world tremble with fear.

"Your Highness is right. With the strength of Qin State, it has already occupied half of the world. If it is defeated one by one, all countries in the world may not be spared. However, I have heard that His Royal Highness's Royal Kingdom occupies thousands of miles in the northern border, with millions of soldiers. Although Qiang Qin is not as good as it is, it is not something Qin can bully." With expectant eyes, Han Fei looked at Zhong Yu.

"My son is right. With the power of our Yuguo, we may not be able to defeat Qin, but it is more than enough to cede the land and defend ourselves! However, if we sit back and watch Qin annex the world, how can our Yuguo resist? We have already integrated the power of the entire world. What about Qin?" Slightly smiling, although Zhong Yu was proud of his national power, he was not complacent.

"So Your Highness wants to unite the six countries to fight against Qin?" Han Fei asked this in excitement.

"Exactly, Qin is not something that any country in the world can resist. It must be resisted by working together. In order to fight against Qin and unite the princes, our Yu Kingdom is willing to send 300,000 troops to destroy the tyranny of Qin." With his lips moving slightly, Zhong Yu Bian said a number that almost shocked Han Fei.

"Your Highness, can you really build up your army?" Han Fei couldn't help being surprised. All along, the princes of the six countries united to fight against Qin, and the troops they sent were no more than this number, or four to five million if more.

"Exactly, the 300,000 troops will be divided into three groups of troops. On the road, 100,000 soldiers will go out from Yanmen County, Beidi County, and Shang County of the Qin State. 100,000 soldiers will be sent from the middle road to join forces with Zhao Yan. Attack Qin Shangdang County , Repeat the battle of Changping. Go down the road, unite the soldiers of Han and Wei, and attack the Hangu Pass of Qin. If we can unite Qi and Chu and send troops to support them, there will be millions of soldiers attacking Qin. , Qin Guo suffered this catastrophe, even if it is not destroyed, it will completely shrink to the west of Hangu Pass, and will not dare to peek at the world." The strategy of attacking Qin, which had been planned for a long time, was finally expressed by Zhong Yu.

"This... If this is true according to His Highness's words, it is indeed difficult for the Qin State to show its fierce power, and great things can be achieved!" Shocked by this grand blueprint, Han Fei stuttered a little.

"It's just that although Gu Wang has a heart, he doesn't know what the princes of the world mean? Are you willing to join forces with Gu, a barbarian from northern Xinjiang, to fight against Qin!" With a sigh, Zhong Yu felt that there was a difference between himself and the princes of the world after all. Yes, they are not countries that belong to the same Zhou king enfeoffment system.

"Your Highness is serious. Looking at His Highness's behavior, many of his attendants behaved with outstanding etiquette and demeanor. He is not a barbarian from northern Xinjiang. But the world has suffered from Qin for a long time. There are benevolent people like Your Highness who attack Qin with troops. The long drought meets the rain, and it is too late to be happy, so how can you refuse!" Seeing the self-deprecating words of this noble man in front of him, Han Fei quickly dissuaded him.

"After all, there is a difference between me and the kings of the world. This is an undeniable thing. Therefore, I want to hire the young master to be the minister of Honglu Temple in my imperial country. From the third-rank official position, I will be in charge of diplomatic reception of other countries." Zhong Yu said The purpose of inviting Han Fei here.

"Honglu Temple Minister? From the third grade?" Han Fei was a little confused, not quite understanding what official Zhong Yu was talking about.

"Our imperial government is divided into three provinces and six departments, nine temples and five supervisors. These institutions are in charge of the country's government and military affairs and are extremely important. He Honglu Temple Minister is one of the nine temples. At the same time, officials at all levels are divided into nine ranks and eighteen ranks. Lu Siqing is the third grade." He briefly introduced the government agencies of his country, so that Han Fei could understand what kind of official title he was awarded.

"Here, from what your Highness said, this Minister of Honglu Temple is the head of the First Department of the Imperial Kingdom. He has an important function and is in charge of diplomatic affairs. Can His Highness accept it easily?" Han Fei was a little surprised by the high authority of this official position. , Could it be that Prince Jing has such great power that he can confer such a big official at will?

"You don't need to doubt this. Before I went on a mission to various countries, I had already discussed with the emperor and the ministers in the court. Such an official position was determined long ago. It's just that the lonely king needs to look carefully at who to award it to. After confirming the manpower, just write down the list and report a copy to Brother Huang!" Hearing Han Fei's question, Zhong Yu felt a little thumped in his heart, but he calmed down and said in person.

There was a silence in the room.

Both of them were thinking about the pros and cons of what one of them just said, especially Han Fei, who suddenly accepted the official position he had dreamed of.

Although it belongs to another country, South Korea that can help him survive is what he needs.
